statement: A fresh source-bound five-node GCP MovieLens run reaches ACTIVE within 60 seconds, materializes complete node logs, and retains no event-loop profile window with a readiness or publication-recovery owner frame above the 3000ms election ceiling, while identical evidence produces identical readiness and publication decisions.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Identical authoritative and cached evidence must produce identical readiness, participation, publication-recovery, and priority-recovery decisions and reason codes. The Quest may change scheduling, coalescing, reuse, and allocation only; it must not weaken admission or synthesize owner decisions.

Every runtime lever requires a deterministic production-path regression that fails before the fix and red-on-revert afterward. Live GCP runs certify the source-bound result only after focused proof is green and are not the iteration loop.
Do not raise election, readiness, admin, or scenario budgets; reduce the synchronous owner work. Do not reduce the five-node workload or expected publication cohort.
Live proof must terminate naturally, bind all five boot fingerprints to current source, match manifest/event/log node sets, and materialize complete per-node logs before it can satisfy doneWhen.
